title: Even the best mesh Wi-Fi system can be easily improved with a simple cable

claims.claim: Mesh sistemleri evdeki ölü bölgeleri ortadan kaldırır ve hızları daha istikrarlı tutar.

evidence.quote: A mesh system eliminates dead zones, however, and keeps speeds more consistent, which is often more important on a daily basis.
A mesh system eliminates dead zones, however, and keeps speeds more consistent

claims.claim: Mesh sistemleri, yönlendiriciler arasında veri taşıyan arka altyapı (backhaul) bağlantısına ihtiyaç duyar.

evidence.quote: All mesh systems require what's called a backhaul connection. This is the pipeline that shuffles data between routers, rather than directly to your devices.

claims.claim: Çift bantlı (dual-band) mesh ürünleri, kablosuz arka altyapıyı cihazların kullandığı bantlarla birleştirir.

evidence.quote: Worse, some cheaper mesh systems merge their wireless backhauls with the same bands your devices rely on, forcing both halves of the equation to suffer.
Worse, some cheaper mesh systems merge their wireless backhauls with the same bands your devices rely on

claims.claim: Özel bir arka altyapı bağlantısına sahip cihazlar en az üç bantlıdır (tri-band), bazı gelişmiş seçenekler ise dört bantlıdır (quad-band).

evidence.quote: For reference, anything with a dedicated backhaul link will at least be tri-band, and some more advanced options are quad-band.

claims.claim: Cat 6 kablo kullanıldığında Ethernet, ortalama bir ev mesafesinde en az 1 Gbps veya daha fazla hız sunar.

evidence.quote: And in the distances of the average home, Ethernet won't lose you a meaningful amount of speed. It will probably deliver at least 1 Gbps, if not more, when you use a Cat 6 cable.

claims.claim: Bir çift 50 feet uzunluğundaki Cat 6 kablo yaklaşık 30 dolara satın alınabilir.

evidence.quote: The basic cost is trivial — you can buy a pair of 50-foot Cat 6 cables for around $30 — but most people don't like wires snaking across their floor.
you can buy a pair of 50-foot Cat 6 cables for around $30

claims.claim: 100 Mbps port mesh sistemler için oldukça yavaştır.

evidence.quote: A 100 Mbps port is simply too slow, and even 1 Gbps can feel subpar if you've got a Wi-Fi 7 system with a dedicated wireless backhaul
A 100 Mbps port is simply too slow

claims.claim: Wi-Fi 7 sistemi kullanan cihazların çoklu gigabit hızlarına ulaşabilmesi için 2.5 veya 10 Gbps Ethernet kullanılması tercih edilir.

evidence.quote: and even 1 Gbps can feel subpar if you've got a Wi-Fi 7 system with a dedicated wireless backhaul, as connecting Wi-Fi devices might be able to achieve multi-gig speeds. It's always preferable to use 2.5 or 10 Gbps Ethernet when it's available
